name: Linux & Shell
description: Working at the Linux command line: files and permissions, text processing, processes, networking tools and shell scripting.

nodes.name: Linux & distros
nodes.desc: Kernel vs distribution, the terminal and the shell.

nodes.name: Shell basics
nodes.desc: Commands, arguments, ls, cd, pwd, tab completion and history.

nodes.name: Filesystem layout
nodes.desc: The directory tree, /etc, /home, /var, /usr and absolute vs relative paths.

nodes.name: Getting help
nodes.desc: man pages, --help and reading command documentation.

nodes.name: Working with files
nodes.desc: cp, mv, rm, mkdir, touch, globbing and viewing files.

nodes.name: Permissions
nodes.desc: rwx bits, chmod, chown, umask and sudo.

nodes.name: Users & groups
nodes.desc: Accounts, groups and /etc/passwd.

nodes.name: Links & inodes
nodes.desc: Inodes, hard links, symbolic links and disk usage.

nodes.name: Pipes & redirection
nodes.desc: stdin, stdout, stderr, redirection and composing commands with pipes.

nodes.name: grep & find
nodes.desc: Searching file contents and the filesystem.

nodes.name: Regular expressions
nodes.desc: Basic and extended regex for grep and sed.

nodes.name: sed & awk
nodes.desc: Stream editing and column-oriented text processing.

nodes.name: Processes & signals
nodes.desc: ps, top, kill, signals, job control and nohup.

nodes.name: Package management
nodes.desc: Installing software with apt, dnf or pacman.

nodes.name: Networking tools
nodes.desc: ping, curl, ss, dig and inspecting network connections.

nodes.name: SSH & remote work
nodes.desc: SSH keys, scp, rsync and working on remote machines.

nodes.name: Bash scripting
nodes.desc: Variables, conditionals, loops, functions and exit codes in bash scripts.

nodes.name: cron & services
nodes.desc: Scheduling jobs with cron and managing services with systemd.

nodes.name: Environment & dotfiles
nodes.desc: Environment variables, PATH, shell configuration and dotfiles.

nodes.name: Log analyzer project
nodes.desc: Write a script that parses server logs and reports top errors and visitors.

nodes.name: Backup script project
nodes.desc: Automate scheduled, rotating backups to a remote machine.
